# UiEmptyState

Explains that there is nothing to show yet and what to do next.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | display |
| Import | `import { UiEmptyState } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import UiEmptyState from '@your-scope/ui/components/UiEmptyState'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/display/UiEmptyState.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/display/UiEmptyState.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` **(required)** | `string` |  | Short statement of what is empty. |
| `description` | `string` |  | What the person can do next. |
| `icon` | `UiIconDefinition \| null` | `iconInbox` | Decorative glyph. Pass `null` to render none. |
| `headingLevel` | `2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6` | `3` |  |
| `size` | `UiSize` | `'md'` | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `UiProvider` `defaults`, then to `ui.config.ts`. |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` |  | Replaces `description`. |
| `icon` |  | Replaces the glyph. |
| `actions` |  | Primary and secondary actions. |

## Attributes

The root `<div>`.

## Accessibility

- The title is a real heading (`headingLevel`).
- The glyph is decorative.

## Styling

- `.vui-empty-state`, `.vui-empty-state__icon`, `.vui-empty-state__title`, `.vui-empty-state__description`, `.vui-empty-state__actions`
- `data-size`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/DisplayDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/DisplayDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<UiCard variant="soft">
  <UiEmptyState :title="t('demo.empty.title')" :description="t('demo.empty.body')" :heading-level="4">
    <template #actions>
      <UiButton>{{ t('demo.empty.action') }}</UiButton>
    </template>
  </UiEmptyState>
</UiCard>
```
